method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equities: Nvidia stands out as broader tech mood cools – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists say the global equity rally lost momentum near record highs as technology shares weakened. The S&P 500 edged lower and the Nasdaq underperformed, with AMD and semiconductor stocks retreating after recent gains.
Equities.reason: Represents the dominant market narrative that AI/tech leadership is concentrated and that a tech regrouping is weighing on the broader rally — high relevance to equity regime and leadership risk.

Equities.title: Asian tech stocks drop with SK Hynix plunging 10% after Wall Street AI names fall
Equities.summary: Despite heightened volatility analysts remain optimistic over the outlook of the tech sector, with J.P. Morgan saying the tech sell-off had not derailed the AI investment cycle.
Equities.reason: Shows global spillover of AI-led volatility into Asian markets and semiconductor names — negative for cyclical/tech risk sentiment and market breadth.

Equities.title: Morning Bid: AI stocks learn to fly — but ain't got wings
Equities.reason: Macro commentary reinforcing that the AI trade is cooling and that lofty expectations are being re-priced — relevant to the prevailing equity regime and momentum narrative.

Equities.title: Hedge Funds Take Big Hit in July After Bruising AI Selloff
Equities.reason: Evidence of leverage losses amplifying market moves. Material for systemic risk and flow dynamics — increases downside sensitivity for equities.

Equities.title: Dow closes at record on Mideast optimism; SpaceX, AMD drag Nasdaq
Equities.reason: Captures an offsetting, market-wide risk-on impulse from easing geopolitical tensions (Mideast) and strong breadth in cyclicals — supportive for major indices, especially the Dow.

Equities.title: JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon warns of high leverage: 'Somebody will disrupt the market'
Equities.summary: JPMorgan Chief Executive Officer Jamie Dimon warned that leverage across financial markets remains elevated, adding that investors should be mindful that hidden borrowing could amplify market disruptions.
Equities.reason: Senior-market warning on leverage increases the probability of episodic volatility and downside risk — relevant to equity risk premia and positioning.

Equities.title: Strong Earnings Power Dow to Another Record
Equities.reason: Frames earnings strength as a core bullish driver for major indices (Dow) — a central supportive macro/earnings narrative for equities.

Rates.title: Fed Governor Cook says she's 'prepared to act' on rate hike to address inflation
Rates.summary: Cook was part of a 9-3 majority that voted last week to keep the central bank's benchmark borrowing rate in a range between 3.5%-3.75%.
Rates.reason: Explicit Fed hawkish rhetoric increases odds of further tightening / higher-for-longer rates → upward pressure on yields (bearish for bond prices).

Rates.title: Fed's Schmid calls for tighter monetary policy to tamp down on 'too high' inflation
Rates.reason: Another Fed official publicly advocating tighter policy reinforces hawkish Fed narrative, weighing on bond prices / pushing yields higher.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: FOMC statement is the primary policy guide; recent communications and data have kept policy on a higher-for-longer path, modestly negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: (BOJ Review) Impact of the Bank of Japan's Reductions in JGB Purchases on the JGB Markets
Rates.reason: BOJ reducing JGB purchases removes a key buyer/support for the market → material upward pressure on Japanese yields and weaker JGB prices.

Rates.title: Japan 30-Year Bond Sale Brings Relief Amid Fiscal Concerns
Rates.reason: Stronger-than-average demand at a long-maturity JGB auction eases near-term issuance/fiscal risk, supporting bond prices (downward pressure on yields).

Rates.title: Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (July-September 2026) (Schedule Updates)
Rates.reason: BOJ schedule updates on outright JGB purchases that signal reduced market support are negative for bond prices (upward yield pressure).

Rates.title: ECB wage tracker at 2.7% in Q1 2027, indicating stable negotiated wage pressures
Rates.reason: Stable negotiated wage growth implies less upside inflation pressure in the euro area → modestly supportive for sovereign bond prices (lower yields).

Rates.title: Kevin Warsh to stick with lean Fed messaging despite market backlash
Rates.summary: US central bank chair remains confident that sweeping reforms will win over key investors
Rates.reason: Persistent hawkish Fed messaging despite market pushback supports higher-for-longer pricing, a headwind for bond prices / upward pressure on yields.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Policy shifts weigh on JPY against US Dollar – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank's Senior Macro Strategist Bas van Geffen discusses renewed Japanese Yen (JPY) weakness following recent joint US-Japan FX intervention that briefly pushed USD/JPY below 156.
FX.reason: Direct USD/JPY commentary tied to policy shifts and recent US-Japan coordinated intervention. This reinforces a USD-strength/JPY-weakness regime and is highly relevant to USD-centric FX flows.

FX.title: Yen struggles to hold intervention gains and drifts towards 158.00
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is ticking lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, trimming gains after an exceptional US-Japan coordinated intervention triggered a 4.5% appreciation late last week.
FX.reason: Continued fading of intervention-driven JPY strength points to renewed USD upside pressure; strong FX-native signal around intervention follow-through and broader USD/JPY trajectory.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index rebounds following Israeli airstrikes, Jobless Claims eyed
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is holding gains after two days of losses and trading around 99.80 during the European session on Thursday.
FX.reason: Core DXY move driven by geopolitical shocks (Israeli airstrikes) and macro data watch; DXY rebound implies broader USD strength across the major currency basket.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar receives support from higher oil prices
FX.summary: USD/CAD loses ground for the second successive day, trading around 1.4010 during the European hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: Oil-driven CAD strength (USD/CAD down) is a clear commodity-to-FX transmission; supports non-USD currency strength vs USD in the CAD pair.

FX.title: Eurozone Retail Sales declines unexpectedly by 0.3% MoM in June
FX.summary: Eurozone Retail Sales contracted at a 0.3% pace Month-on-Month (MoM) in June, while they were anticipated to have risen moderately by 0.1%, from 0.4% in May, revised higher from 0.2%.
FX.reason: Weaker-than-expected eurozone retail data is a negative for EUR vs USD, reinforcing near-term USD strength in EURUSD and the broader USD basket.

FX.title: Korean Won Rises to Highest Since October on Exporters Dollar Sales
FX.reason: Exporter dollar-selling leading to KRW strength represents a direct FX flow reducing USD demand; relevant to USD-basket dynamics and EM/Asia FX flows.

FX.title: Australian Dollar eases from highs as the impact from Trade Balance figures fade
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) posts moderate losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, retreating to the 0.7040 area from three-week highs at 0.7064 on Wednesday.
FX.reason: AUD weakness vs USD after fading domestic data impact feeds into the broader USD-strength narrative across commodity-linked currencies.

FX.title: US Dollar: Wait-and-see mood before payrolls – ING
FX.summary: ING’s FX Strategist Francesco Pesole notes improved Gulf-related risk sentiment has weighed slightly on the Dollar, but stable Federal Reserve rate expectations remain supportive.
FX.reason: Highlights that Fed-rate expectations are still underpinning USD demand even as geopolitical risk ebbs; supports the near-term USD-positive bias ahead of payrolls.

FX.title: Indian Rupee ticks down, awaiting clarity on Hormuz deal
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday. The USD/INR pair rises to near 95.22 after rebounding from the fresh monthly low of 94.83 posted the previous day.
FX.reason: USD/INR uptick reflects local/geo uncertainty and USD demand; relevant to EM FX and USD flow dynamics but lower market-wide impact than major-pair moves.

Commodities.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD bulls target $4,380 buoyed by lower US yields
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) consolidates gains after appreciating nearly $200 this week, buoyed by lower US Treasury yields as traders dial down bets of immediate Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hikes.
Commodities.reason: Gold rally tied to materially lower US yields and fading near-term Fed hike bets — constructive for precious metals price; clear cross-market transmission (rates -> gold).

Commodities.title: Gold: Breakout extends as yields ease – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC’s Christopher Wong and Sim Moh Siong highlight a sharp rebound in Gold as easing Middle East tensions weighed on Oil and US Treasury yields, softening the US Dollar.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note that easing Middle East tensions and lower yields/dollar are extending gold's breakout — confirms market flow driving the move (moderate relevance).

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD clings to gains near $62 with US NFP in focus
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) holds onto two-day gains at around $62.00 during the European trading session on Thursday. The white metal trades firmly amid hopes of a further decline in oil prices.
Commodities.reason: Silver supported by metals complex/expectations of lower oil (costs/industrial tone) and macro drivers (rates/USD); positive but smaller magnitude than gold — moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: China's crude oil imports fell in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: China, the world's largest importer of crude oil, imported less crude oil in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) following higher crude oil prices that resulted from disrupted flows through the Strait of Hormuz. China's lower imports reduced global demand, softe
Commodities.reason: Material decline in China's imports reduces global oil demand — negative for crude prices and energy complex; high relevance given China's size as a marginal demand driver.

Commodities.title: Iran says it has reached agreement with Oman on Hormuz shipping route
Commodities.summary: Islamic republic is determined to retain a degree of control over the chokepoint
Commodities.reason: A formal Iran‑Oman agreement reducing Strait of Hormuz risk premium is a significant geopolitical de‑escalation for oil — meaningful negative shock to price risk premia and nearby forwards.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Three-Day Drop as Iran, Oman Reach Hormuz Agreement
Commodities.reason: Market reaction: sustained multi‑day oil pullback following the Iran‑Oman deal — confirms the near‑term negative pricing impulse across crude markets.

Commodities.title: Ukraine’s military hits one of Russia’s biggest oil refineries in long-range drone attack
Commodities.summary: The Slavneft-Yanos facility in Yaroslavl, which is situated hundreds of miles from the Ukraine border, is one of Russia's biggest oil refineries.
Commodities.reason: Attack on a major Russian refinery represents a tangible supply disruption risk to refined product flows — bullish for crude/product prices and adds volatility to energy complex.

Crypto.title: Coldcard hack sparks a self-custody security overhaul: Cory Klippsten
Crypto.reason: Major hardware-wallet exploit undermines confidence in self-custody, an immediate negative for retail crypto trust and flows. High relevance because it represents a large on-chain loss and prompts sector-wide security reassessment.

Crypto.title: Coldcard exploit could boost demand for regulated bitcoin exposure, analysts say
Crypto.reason: Analyst view that security failures may shift flows toward regulated custodial products and ETFs. Positive for institutional/regulatory product demand but secondary to the immediate negative confidence hit.

Crypto.title: The $120 million Coldcard hack lights up Bitcoin's memory pool
Crypto.reason: On-chain evidence of a large exploit increases near-term sell pressure and volatility for Bitcoin; meaningful market-impacting event but somewhat technical in nature.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin developers flag 85 critical bugs in an "extremely bad" situation
Crypto.reason: Widespread critical bugs in Bitcoin codebase raise systemic protocol risk and could dent confidence in the chain — a high-relevance negative for crypto markets and infrastructure trust.

Crypto.title: Yellow Card raises $40 million to link banks to stablecoin processing
Crypto.reason: Funding to connect banks with stablecoin rails is pro-integration and institutional adoption, supportive for crypto's plumbing and transactional utility.

Crypto.title: Nomura’s Laser Digital backs ZIGChain for onchain private credit push in UAE
Crypto.reason: Institutional bank-backed onchain credit initiatives point to continued institutionalization and product development in crypto finance — modestly bullish for adoption.

Crypto.title: NFT startup founder charged with misusing funds from $10 million fundraising
Crypto.reason: Fraud/charges in the NFT sector reinforce legal and trust headwinds for retail and institutional investors — negative but limited to the NFT/venture segment.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin steadies above $64,000 as traders watch $100 billion SpaceX unlock
Crypto.reason: Price-stability coverage around a notable Bitcoin level and potential cross-asset liquidity event; modestly positive but primarily a short-term price/flow note (lower relevance).

Crypto.title: Live updates: Coinbase lets UK users trade U.S. equities. BTC trades near $65,000
Crypto.reason: Coinbase product expansion to UK equities trading signals platform growth and broader crypto platform utility; small positive for adoption, limited market-moving impact.

Crypto.title: XRP whales keep buying the dip, but ether shows deeper capitulation
Crypto.reason: Altcoin rotation: concentrated buying in XRP versus ETH capitulation suggests uneven risk appetite across tokens. Mixed-to-negative for broader altcoin risk, modest relevance.
